hero_kpi_rationale: 60% adjusted operating margin reflects a key profitability target maintained annually through 2028 in a contracting tobacco sector, demonstrating financial discipline and the ability to generate stable cash flows despite market challenges.

kpis.name: Adjusted Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Group's adjusted operating margin, a target maintained each year.
kpis.description: Altria aims to maintain an adjusted margin of at least 60% annually through 2028, despite volume pressures.
kpis.signal: High target margin despite the tobacco market contraction.

kpis.name: Adjusted Diluted EPS Growth
kpis.explanation: Compound annual growth rate of adjusted diluted earnings per share.
kpis.description: Altria targets a mid-single-digit CAGR for its adjusted diluted EPS by 2028 from a 2022 base of $4.87.
kpis.signal: Modest growth target despite tobacco decline.

kpis.name: Net Debt to Consolidated EBITDA Ratio
kpis.explanation: Ratio of net debt to earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization.
kpis.description: Altria targets a debt-to-EBITDA ratio of approximately 2.0x by 2028.
kpis.signal: Clear solvency target despite share repurchases.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share Growth
kpis.explanation: Target for annual dividend per share growth.
kpis.description: Altria targets mid-single-digit annual dividend growth through 2028.
kpis.signal: Strong commitment to shareholders despite transition.

kpis.name: Cumulative Operating Cost Savings
kpis.explanation: Cost savings targets from the Optimize Accelerate optimization initiative.
kpis.description: Altria targets $600 million in cumulative cost savings by end of 2029 through its Optimize Accelerate optimization initiative announced in October 2024.
kpis.signal: Cost reductions to fund transformation and Vision 2028.

kpis.name: Industry Cigarette Volume Decline
kpis.explanation: Estimated decline rate of total cigarette volume in the United States.
kpis.description: Industry volume decline is estimated at 6.5% in Q4 2025, an improvement of 1.5 points from 8% a year earlier, primarily due to moderating growth of illicit e-vapor products.
kpis.signal: Slowing decline, indicating partial stabilization due to moderating growth of illicit e-vapor products.

kpis.name: Discount Brand Market Share
kpis.explanation: Market share held by low-price cigarette brands in the total category.
kpis.description: Discount brand share reached 32.9% in Q4 2025, up 2.6 points year-over-year, reflecting inflationary pressures on adult consumers' discretionary income.
kpis.signal: Increased pressure on premium brands due to consumer purchasing power constraints.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Total amount paid in dividends per share over the fiscal year. Key indicator for income-oriented investors.
kpis.description: 5-year history of declared dividends per share (2021-2025).

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Annual total of cash returned to shareholders: dividends paid + share buybacks (treasury stock).
kpis.description: For 2025: cumulative dividends + share buybacks in billions USD.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Share of net income distributed as dividends. Above 80% indicates a potentially unsustainable dividend.
kpis.description: Dividends / net income for 2025 (based on net income attributable to shareholders).

kpis.name: Basic Earnings Per Share
kpis.explanation: Net income attributable to shareholders divided by the average number of shares outstanding.
kpis.description: EPS declined from $6.54 in 2024 to $4.12 in 2025, primarily impacted by goodwill impairment of $1.158 Bn and asset exit costs. Excluding exceptional items, underlying operational performance remains solid.

kpis.name: Operating Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Net cash generated by operating activities, reflecting the company's real earnings capacity.
kpis.description: Operating cash flow reached $9.29 Bn in 2025, up from $8.75 Bn in 2024, demonstrating robust cash generation model despite exceptional charges. This level supports dividend payments and share buybacks.

kpis.name: Declared Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Total dividends declared per common share for the fiscal year, a key indicator of shareholder return policy.
kpis.description: Altria maintains steady dividend progression: $3.84 in 2023, $4.00 in 2024, and $4.16 in 2025, representing +4.0% YoY. Total cash dividends paid in 2025 reached $6.96 Bn.

kpis.name: Consolidated Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Ratio of gross profit to net revenue, measuring production efficiency before overhead.
kpis.description: Gross margin improved to 62.5% in 2025 ($14,542M / $23,279M) versus 59.8% in 2024, driven by lower cost of goods sold (-7.9%) and excise taxes (-12.2%) despite net revenue contraction (-3.1%).

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Investments in property, plant and equipment reflecting maintenance and development of the industrial base.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures rebounded to $216M in 2025 after reaching a low of $142M in 2024, notably supported by increased construction in progress ($320M vs $199M on balance sheet). Remains modest relative to operating cash flow (CapEx/OCF ratio of 2.3%).

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company explicitly states that increased competition, particularly in innovative nicotine products (e-vapor, nicotine pouches, heated tobacco), is a key factor that could negatively affect the business. Item 1A.

risks.title: Regulation
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations on nicotine products. Changes in these regulations, especially regarding innovative products and e-vapor, could have a material impact on the business. Item 1A.

risks.title: Illicit e-vapor trade
risks.score_rationale: The proliferation of illicit flavored e-vapor products contributed to 2-3% of cigarette volume decline in 2025 (versus 3-4% previously), directly impacting cigarette demand and market share. Item 7 MD&A.

risks.title: Structural decline in tobacco market
risks.score_rationale: The 6.5% industry volume decline in Q4 2025 reflects structural compression in the U.S. cigarette market, affecting all manufacturers. Item 7 MD&A.

risks.title: Product innovation and acceptance
risks.score_rationale: The company must innovate with smoke-free products, but the e-vapor market remains disrupted by illicit products and product legitimacy acceptance remains uncertain. The company recorded impairments in 2025. Item 7 MD&A.

risks.title: Discretionary income pressures
risks.score_rationale: Persistent inflationary pressures on consumer discretionary income in 2025 resulted in a 2.6-point increase in discount brand market share, impacting premium brands. Item 7 MD&A.

risks.title: Acquisitions and partnerships
risks.score_rationale: The company holds minority stakes in ABI and Cronos and a majority joint venture Horizon for HTS products. Integration and realization of benefits carry risks. Item 1 and Item 7.

risks.title: Litigation
risks.score_rationale: The company may be involved in litigation related to nicotine products, regulations and health, which could affect the business and reputation. Item 1A.

risks.title: Reputation and perception
risks.score_rationale: The company's reputation may be affected by the addictive nature of nicotine products, litigation, regulatory changes and consumer preferences. Item 1A.

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence in the provided 10-K report.
